_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: From the farthest parts of the earth he gathers us home.
We come radiant, and our sorrow turns to joy.
From his fullness we have all received.
Grace upon grace upon grace.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
And we have seen his glory.
Come, let us worship the God who blesses us.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: He has gathered us from the far country, from the north and the ends of the earth, and turned our weeping into a watered garden.
Glory to God in the highest!
From the fullness of the Word made flesh we have all received — grace, and then more grace, and grace upon that.
Glory to God in the highest!
Before the world was made he chose us, named us his own children, and blessed us with every blessing of heaven.
Glory to God in the highest!
So we come home radiant over the goodness of the Lord, and we sing in the company of the redeemed.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: He gathers us home from the ends of the earth.
Glory to God in the highest!
From his fullness we receive grace upon grace.
Glory to God in the highest!
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
Glory to God in the highest!
Come, let us worship and behold his glory.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.
